To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel KNMF and a generalized KHONMF for microarray data analysis and demonstrate the superior performance of these methods on several microarray datasets.
we propose a novel Kernel NMF (KNM) and its extension to high order KNMF for microarray data analysis and our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art KNMF and NMF.

a novel kernel non-negative matrix factorizations (KNMFs) approach for feature extractions and classification of microarrays is proposed and it outperforms traditional NMF and other KNMFs on eight microarray data sets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel KNMF and KHONMF for microarray data analysis, and our approach has been demonstrated to be effective for microarray data classification.
the development and application of a new kernel NMF approach for feature extraction of microarray data.
a novel kernel NFM and its application in high-order microarray analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed KNMF and KHONMF methods are effective and promising for analyzing high dimensional microarray data.
the proposed KNMF and KHONMF are powerful and efficient tools for feature extraction and data analysis in microarray datasets.
the proposed KNMF and KHONMF approaches are promising and can be used to extract discriminative features from microarray data for classification.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our KNMF approach can capture the non-linear discriminative information of microarray data, and our HONMF approach can capture higher-order discriminative information.
our approach can be a good alternative to existing KNMFs for microarray analysis.
the proposed KNMF and KHONMF can be used as a general framework for feature extraction and data classification of microarray datasets, which may be applied in other fields.
The main takeaway from our work is that
KNMF and KHONMF can extract more non-linear discriminant features than NMF and HONMF.
the kernel NMF can be generalized to high-order NMF and it can be used to extract more discriminative features for better microarray data analysis.
the proposed kernel non-negative matrix factorizations are useful for microarray classification.
